description: Best tool for activity totals and trends (e.g. 'how far did I run each month', 'has my pace improved'). Fetches every matching activity in the range and returns only aggregates per period and type: count, distance (km and mi), moving time, elevation, longest, average speed and pace (distance-weighted), fastest average pace, average HR, training load, and time in HR zones 1-5 (minutes and %, for zone 2 / 80-20 questions). Range up to 366 days.

activity_subtype.description: Subtype key within activity_type, e.g. trail_running, treadmill_running, road_cycling.

activity_type.description: Parent type key, e.g. running, cycling, swimming, strength_training, walking, hiking.

area.description: Only activities that started inside this latitude/longitude box (decimal degrees).

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

event_type.description: Only activities tagged with this event type, e.g. race.

exclude_children.description: Hide the legs of multisport activities (e.g. a triathlon's swim/bike/run), keeping the parent.

name_contains.description: Text the activity name contains (case-insensitive), e.g. 'parkrun' or 'tempo'.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: summarize_activities
title: Summarize activities
